claims.text: Recommended: doxycycline 100 mg PO BID × 7 days. Alt: azithromycin 1 g PO once, or levofloxacin 500 mg PO daily × 7 days.
claims.quote: Doxycycline 100 mg orally 2 times/day for 7 days Alternative Regimens Azithromycin 1 g orally in a single dose or Levofloxacin 500 mg orally once daily for 7 days
claims.locator: Workowski KA, et al. Sexually Transmitted Infections Treatment Guidelines, 2021. MMWR Recomm Rep 2021;70(4):1-187

claims.text: Asymptomatic partners: treat presumptively w a chlamydia regimen (doxycycline).
claims.quote: Asymptomatic partners should be presumptively treated with a chlamydia regimen (doxycycline 100 mg orally 2 times/day for 7 days)
claims.locator: Workowski KA, et al. Sexually Transmitted Infections Treatment Guidelines, 2021. MMWR Recomm Rep 2021;70(4):1-187
